name: dotnet-port-scan
description: Make an inventory of a .NET Framework solution before it is moved to modern .NET: project style, target frameworks, project kind, packages.config and PackageReference, project and framework-only assembly references, Web Forms, WCF and ASMX files, web.config modules, handlers and binding redirects, and a suggested move order. Reads files only; never runs dotnet, msbuild or nuget, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
